body.heading: Set up shop
paragraphs: Line up your boxes and tins on a table or blanket. Every shop needs a counter and a friendly shopkeeper.
Give each thing a price in pretend coins: two lids for the pasta, three for the jam.

body.heading: Open for customers
paragraphs: Customers choose, count out their coins, and say thank you. Shopkeepers say: Have a lovely day!
Swap jobs so everyone gets to shop and everyone gets to sell.

takeaway: A shop is a game about choosing, counting, and being polite.
materials: Clean empty boxes and tins from home
Big lids or leaves as pretend coins
safetyNotes: An adult checks the pretend coins are big and the shop things are clean and safe to handle.
screenFreeExtension: Draw price tags for your shop with dots to count instead of numbers.
